proposals: NaBFID should publish a quarterly list of every bond issued under its Partial Credit Enhancement facility, with issuer, project, amount, and rating before and after enhancement, so the ₹15,000 crore H2 FY2025-26 target can be checked against completed issuance rather than stated intent.

REC, PFC and IREDA should disclose in their annual reports the all-in hedged cost of each foreign-currency borrowing next to the average rate charged on the rupee loans it funds, so the spread advantage the post says survives hedging can be seen reaching, or not reaching, projects.

The RBI should add to its monthly external commercial borrowing release a split by borrower type (PSU lenders versus project SPVs) and by hedged versus unhedged exposure, so the claim that SPV-level foreign-currency debt is structurally rare can be counted instead of asserted.

IRDAI and PFRDA should publish each year the amount of credit-enhanced infrastructure bonds held by insurers and pension funds, by rating, so it is visible whether the A-to-AA lift actually unlocks the institutional money the facility was built for, unlike the 2015 bank-PCE framework.
